contrastive.explanation: Rejecting F2, F3 would leave no surviving signal and the policy would land on benign — the opposite of the human-review path we chose.

risk.rationale: Verified evidence shows a confirmed account-takeover chain: an OWA-created inbox forwarding rule to an external Proton address (F3, T1114.003) plus confirmed repeated sign-ins from a non-baseline datacenter ASN (F2, T1078.004). The rejected impossible-travel claim only weakens a travel-based inference; it does not explain away the external forwarding rule or the anomalous authentication events. No data-quality conflicts are present. Contain the account: reset credentials, revoke sessions, remove the forwarding rule, and review mailbox/audit logs.
escalate_reasons: signals of compromise without a confirmed abuse chain
